response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and infrastructure experience with relevant exposure to AI-agent workflows and cloud technologies. While his direct GenAI production experience is limited, his technical leadership, open-source contributions, and recent work with Model Context Protocol (MCP) align well with the role's requirements. His diverse background suggests adaptability, though deeper GenAI expertise would strengthen his candidacy.
strengths: Extensive experience (10+ years) in full-stack development with TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud platforms (AWS), aligning with the role's technical stack.
Proven technical leadership, including mentoring teams, driving engineering excellence, and contributing to open-source projects like GISCollective and MCP tooling.
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) code generators and frameworks for agentic workflows at re:cinq.
concerns: Limited explicit experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures or vector databases, which are critical for the role.
While he has built data pipelines, the resume lacks clear examples of production-grade AI/ML systems or LLM optimization techniques.
No advanced degree (Master's/PhD) in AI or related fields, which is a preferred qualification for the role.
